final: SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () - AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan
